title: lewisia pygmaea subsp. longipetala
intro: Lewisia pygmaea subsp. longipetala, commonly known as the long-petaled lewisia, is a plant species in the portulacaceae family. It is a perennial, flowering plant native to the western United States and Canada. The health benefits of Lewisia pygmaea subsp. longipetala include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include expectorant, diuretic, and antiseptic actions, attributed to the bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
